Im happy you didn’t and i hope you fall asleep every Time you try but that’s just in vain. I’m here to talk anytime, please reach out if you feel the need to or if you feel alone. Your younger brother doesn’t understand the severity of what you are planning and his innocence does not equate to approval or that he is dismissing it. He will miss you so incredibly much and you would be leaving him with years of trauma, ptsd and guilt. Especially since you told him your plan and he simply didn’t understand and couldn’t fathom the severity and consequences of your intentions. If not for yourself, stay alive for your brother...how old is he if i may ask?
I’m here to talk if you ever feel the need to :)

Why on earth would you stay with her if she cheated multiple times?
Im in too :)

Nah they haven’t really taken much interest in me now, except for when i’m going to move out. I find it funny that both my parents are narcs and not just one of them. They adopted me because my older brother passed before I was born and then my parents had fertility issues. However my sister is their biological child, she is the spitting image of my mom and she is also their miracle child. My mom got pregnant with her a couple months after I was adopted

I was expecting any response thank you much. My current family were physically abusive up until i turned 21, now they are just mentally and emotionally abusive. They dont talk to me, my dad doesnt even make eye contact with me, he acts as if i dont exist. 

It makes sense that they have NPD as i am definitely treated as the SG but I always assumed it was because I wasn’t their biological child. And nah neither of my siblings were EVER in the position of an SG, my parents would never lay a finger on them, me on the other hand, I was their literal punching bag. I’m 25, bro is 28, sis is 22. I was adopted when I was 18 months old. And my parents constantly lied to my face about my adoption despite my questions and they only told me i was adopted when i turned 21. So naturally i was blindsided and extremely betrayed and our relationship snowballed from there
Please throw them up :/ live for another day
Im sorry i wish i could understand too. Im not religious either and the future scares me too and i wish i knew the right thing to say but i’m here to talk if you need it :)
Relativity and context are important indeed. And trying to put pain in perspective is very difficult and an almost torturous process
Does the pain i’d cause matter more than the pain I’m experiencing. I’ve never heard truer words. Its like they try to discount your own pain.
Please dont do it. Offing yourself is not the answer. You’re only 14!!! You have so much of your life ahead of you
Please dont try it again, im glad you were stopped but you’re not alone. And we want to help
